description: A raw block's source → how a code fence is shown (architecture §7.1). Display only: the block still saves its source unchanged. `fence` is null when the block isn't a fence; otherwise `lang` is the first word of the info string and `code` is the content without the fence lines, with up to the opening fence's indent removed from each line.

cases.name: only the first word of the info string
a shorter run is code, not the close
indented code is not a fence
a rule is not a fence
a table is not a fence
